hooks.command: nohup graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1 & ls -d graphify-out/[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9] 2>/dev/null | sort -r | tail -n +4 | xargs rm -rf
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Start-Process -FilePath graphify -ArgumentList 'update','.' -WindowStyle Hidden; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'graphify-out' -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Name -match '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -Skip 3 | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
